column3: ## Verify API created article display on Public Article Landing Page

column1: Depends on API : CRUD Articles : Create an article with multiple author affiliations via CRUD API

column3: Navigate to the public article landing page at /article/<article_id>

column4: Article title "API Multi-Affiliation Research" is displayed
Both authors "Jane Doe" and "Bob Smith" are displayed

column3: Click on the "Affiliations" accordion button under the authors list

column4: Under "Jane Doe", both "University of Oxford" and "Harvard University" are displayed on separate lines
Under "Bob Smith", "MIT", "Stanford University", and "Cambridge University" are displayed on separate lines
Clicking on an author's ORCID link opens their ORCID profile in a new tab
